new_result.statement: For three original physical rows H and disjoint original bank J, if M=A[H,J] has rank two, n spans its physical left kernel, V2=e2(MM^T), and kappa0=|n^T A[H,H]n|>0, then the full ambient quadratic form has a continuous C0 density satisfying ||p_Q||inf <= ((15/4)12^(1/5)) [V2*kappa0]^(-1/5), retaining arbitrary signs, same-bank curvature, outside couplings and affine terms.

structural_identity: Writing M=[K;alpha^T K], v=(-alpha,1), n=v/||v|| and a_eff=v^T A[H,H]v, one has det(KK^T)|a_eff|=e2(MM^T)|n^T A[H,H]n|.

partner_application.application: On its strict-N3 Hadamard family, choose H=(U1,U2,Z1) and condition on Z2: V2=epsilon^-2, kappa0=epsilon, so ||p_Q||inf <=6.1641 epsilon^(1/5)<=6.1641 for 0<epsilon<=1. This shows one source-disjoint scalar square already suffices with the rank-two cross packet.

next_step: Route exact-rank-two cross survivors with zero or very small physical kernel curvature to exact-null/near-null coloop, grouped-square, hub/star, ridge, pair, or higher-volume exits without selecting a tiny local minor.
